s01.narration: How many hours a week should each person work? Hi, I'm Maria from the Sloneek team, and I'll show you how to create and assign working hours.

s02.narration: Working hours, called a work contract in the app, define when someone is supposed to work. Without them, a person can't take absences or record attendance.

s03.narration: In the left menu, I open Settings. You'll find working hours in the Work contracts setup row.

s04.narration: When I open it, you see the list of templates: whether they're active, whether they're weekly or annual, and their note.

s05.narration: I create a new template with the Add button. The New work contract type form opens.

s06.narration: You can start from a predefined template, such as Full Time or Half Time. But I'll start from scratch.

s07.narration: In the Name field, I type Part-time, 30 hours. I enter the same text in the English translation, too.

s08.narration: In the note, I briefly describe who the template is for. I leave the Active switch on, so the template can be used.

s09.narration: A work contract can be weekly or annual. A weekly schedule repeats every week and suits regular work.

s10.narration: An annual schedule is set for each day of the year separately, for example for shifts. I'll keep Weekly.

s11.narration: I've saved the template. Below the form, a new table has appeared for the weekly working hours setting.

s12.narration: Sloneek has pre-filled a standard week: Monday to Friday, nine to five-thirty, with a thirty-minute break. The weekly fund is forty hours.

s13.narration: The Reset button clears the table, and Normal brings back exactly this standard week.

s14.narration: For a part-time contract, I change the End of working hours in Monday's row to three-thirty.

s15.narration: With Copy the first line, I copy Monday's times to the whole week.

s16.narration: The copy also went to the weekend, so for Saturday and Sunday, I untick Workday. The fund now shows thirty hours.

s17.narration: The breaks are on the right. The lunch break from twelve to twelve-thirty doesn't count as working time.

s18.narration: Sloneek calculates the half-shift length on its own. Half-day absences are based on it.

s19.narration: Finally, I save the schedule with the Save button above the table. Without it, the changes wouldn't take effect.

s20.narration: You assign the template in the user's profile. Under Users, I open Management, search for James, and open his profile.

s21.narration: Here, on the Contract and Payroll tab, you see all of James's work contracts.

s22.narration: James works full-time, forty hours a week, for an indefinite period. The green row marks the work contract that applies today.

s23.narration: Soon he's moving to part-time. Work contracts can't overlap, so I first end the current one with Edit.

s24.narration: I untick Indefinite period, enter the last full-time day in Valid until, and confirm the change.

s25.narration: Now I click Add a new type of work contract and search for Part-time, 30 hours.

s26.narration: I tick Indefinite period and set Valid from to the day after the full-time contract ends. Then I save.

s27.narration: The new contract follows on from the old one, and the history stays. Don't change contracts in the past; it would recalculate the balances of absences already taken.

s28.narration: Sloneek deducts public holidays from a weekly template automatically, based on the Country of operation in Basic and work data.

s29.narration: In attendance, the work contract sets the working hours fund and the balance, and Free time absences reduce the fund. Attendance can also add the contract's breaks automatically.

s30.narration: To see who has no work contract, or whose contract ends soon, open Settings check in the Settings menu.

s31.narration: You can't change an assigned template; there's a lock on the schedule. If you need different times, use Duplicate and edit the copy.

s32.narration: You can only delete a template that nobody has. If you no longer want to use it, just deactivate it.

s33.narration: I click Yes, and Sloneek stops the deletion, because James already has this template.

s34.narration: A final tip: you can set the work contract for new colleagues right when you create them, or let HR Workflows assign it for you.

s35.narration: Now you know how to create working hours, assign them, and change them safely. If something doesn't work, check the Help Center.

s36.narration: Less admin, more time for people. This is Sloneek.
